_comment: Proposed names for windows whose body is shared by several reference functions. A body cannot decide between them; the callers and callees can. For each window, every candidate name gathers its co-called and co-calling names from the five reference binaries, and the candidate whose neighbourhood overlaps this window's already-named neighbours most is proposed. Sole winner with a positive score only. PROPOSALS: they are not landed in config/symbol_names*.txt and each needs the same review a mined name gets before it is allowed to rename a definition.
